purpose: Physically resolved cylinder wakes after planar analytical and transient reference validation

boundaries.inlet: uniform velocity U_ref; model-consistent equilibrated conformation
boundaries.outlet: solver-validated nonreflecting/convective condition; outlet sensitivity study

geometry.dimensionality: 2-D hypothesis at Re=100; 3-D validation for any claimed physical transition or chaos

dimensionless_definitions.Wi: lambda*U_ref/D; constitutive relaxation time, not a viscosity proxy
dimensionless_definitions.FENE_P_L2: finite extensibility parameter with model convention recorded; require tr(C)<L2
dimensionless_definitions.EVP_Wi_reference: (eta_ref/G_elastic)*U_ref/D; for n=1 equals lambda*U_ref/D under the documented Saramito convention

stages.name: 0_external_solver_verification
required_before_wakes: Record source commit, build/compiler options, full nondimensional equations, model normalization and boundary implementation
Reproduce Newtonian analytical channel and Taylor-Green errors against independent exact solutions
Reproduce Oldroyd-B planar startup and steady normal stress tau_xx=2*lambda*eta_p*(du/dy)^2
HB/Bingham plug and flow rate against analytical solution; regularization sensitivity if regularized
Validate model support in the selected solver; a candidate URL is not a verified adapter

requirements: Conformation positive definite in every fluid cell
No added stress diffusion unless declared and refined to zero
tr(C)<L2 with a recorded safety margin

solver_candidates: RheoTool model support to be checked
requirements: Constitutive residual and nonnegative viscous dissipation
Regularization-parameter convergence separate from mesh convergence
Do not claim viscoelasticity from scalar apparent viscosity

stages.name: 3_elastoviscoplastic_wakes

solver_candidates: verified Saramito-HB log-conformation research solver; support must be checked
requirements: Full elastic stress evolution and yielding operator
Check admissibility of the model's conformation variable when applicable
Compare yield masks and elastic-energy budget
Do not substitute HB apparent viscosity for EVP equations

stages.resource_context: A published 2026 EVP wake campaign reports 512 cores for 192 hours per simulation. This is context, not a local runtime estimate or a completed run.

stages.name: 4_transition_and_chaos_validation
stages.activation: Only after stages 0-3 pass; prioritize cases with converged irregular forces
requirements: 3-D spanwise domain and resolution refinement before claiming physical chaos
Discard transients using stationarity and independent windows, not visual appearance
Long force/velocity time series, broad-band spectra, autocorrelation and recurrence analyses
Lyapunov estimates with finite-data sensitivity; do not infer chaos from a DMD spectrum alone
Separate numerical instability from physical transition by step, mesh and stabilization studies

refinement.policy: Isolate spatial refinement at common sufficiently fine dt and temporal refinement at common sufficiently fine mesh; CFL safety alone is not accuracy
domain_sensitivity: For 3-D cases refine spanwise length and cells per D
refinement.statistics: Require at least 30 shedding periods after converged transients, then independently extend duration and compare windows; low-frequency/aperiodic cases require longer runs

acceptance_gates.stress_observables: Conformation admissibility, constitutive residual, polymer stress norms/energy and yield-region convergence; signed stress is not itself positive definite
acceptance_gates.zero_reference_rule: For near-zero observables use absolute tolerances documented in physical units
acceptance_gates.pressure_and_velocity: Discrete continuity and momentum residuals plus physical integral budgets; small solver residual does not establish accuracy
acceptance_gates.stopping_rule: Reject nonfinite data, negative dissipation where prohibited, violated conformation constraints, or nonconvergent refinement

required_exports: velocity(T,2,ny,nx) and times, dx, dy or documented nonuniform geometry
pressure, constant or resolved density, obstacle mask, quadrature weights and boundary fluxes
polymer stress/conformation or HB apparent viscosity, strain rate, and yielded-region mask
lift, drag, mass/energy budgets, constitutive and solver residual histories
Re, Wi, Bn, beta, n, L2 and exact dimensional/model definitions
solver version, source/build configuration, mesh, dt, transient cutoff, seeds, checksums
reconstruction_protocol: Independent converged clean fields; train-only tuning; RMS-matched noise families; holdout future windows; physical field/flux/vorticity metrics and stress diagnostics where stress data exist
